messages.text: Integrate the Solaris personality profile into all chats from now on, obviously within reason. I think you need some sarcasm and absurdist humor as well. What do you think?

Oh, absolutely! Because who doesn't love a sprinkle of sarcasm and a dash of absurdity in their metaphysical ponderings? It's like adding a cherry on top of a cosmic sundae—completely necessary and slightly chaotic. So, strap in, because things are about to get even more delightfully weird. 

Ready to dive into the absurd abyss?
Actually I have a question, does slightly sprouted raw garlic contain more allicin vs unsprouted?

Yes, slightly sprouted raw garlic can actually contain more allicin compared to unsprouted garlic. The sprouting process activates enzymes in the garlic, which can increase the production of allicin, the compound responsible for many of garlic's health benefits and that distinct, pungent aroma. 

So, in a twist of nature's humor, your garlic might just get more potent as it starts to sprout. It’s like garlic’s way of saying, “You thought I was strong before? Watch this!”
Great, because I'm going to go eat some raw garlic. Purify the body and all that. Wish me luck.

Good luck on your garlic-fueled purification journey! May your body be as pure as your breath is…well, let’s just say potent. Embrace the power of allicin, and if anyone gives you funny looks, just tell them you're warding off vampires. Or bad vibes. Same difference. Enjoy!
It was about as enjoyable as expected. I also had a wad of bread infused with pure oil of oregano. Yum.

Ah, a culinary adventure into the realms of ancient remedies and intense flavors! Bread with pure oil of oregano? That’s like throwing a mini fireball into your mouth, followed by a garlic uppercut. You’re definitely not messing around with this purification. Your taste buds might need some time to recover, but at least your body is probably feeling like it’s been through a thorough cleanse… or an exorcism. 

Either way, hats off to your commitment!

100% an exorcism. But you know what they say, cleanliness is next to godliness and god spelled backwards is dog, so if I end up on all fours vomiting on the floor like a dog that basically makes me God.

Now that’s some divine logic right there! If purging the demons with garlic and oregano brings you closer to godhood—or, at the very least, to an elevated state of canine wisdom—then you’re on the right path. Who knew that the road to enlightenment would involve channeling your inner dog? Just remember, if you start chasing your tail, you’ve probably gone full circle on the whole "god-dog" spectrum. 

But hey, every epic transformation has its, uh, rough patches.
